Read and agree to consent statement

It is necessary for you to supply us with personal data in connection with the Olam sustainability programme of which you are part of. This personal data will be collected and stored on the Olam Farmer Information System ("OFIS"). You may subsequently withdraw any consent given for our collection, use and disclosure of your personal data. However, failure to supply your personal data and/or subsequent withdrawal of your consent may result in you being unable to participate in the sustainability programme.
Your personal data will be used on the OFIS to help populate information on:
The mapping software. This is designed to showcase the farm and infrastructure locations and provide more detailed information about Farmers linked to their geographical location.

Analysis software. This looks at a Farmer\'s personal data against aggregate data in order to help determine the future direction of the programme. OFIS users are able to export the analysis (and data behind the analysis, such as a Farmer\'s personal data) into either a PDF or excel spreadsheet. This export function allows users to identify specific Farmers, with, for example, the highest or lowest productivity levels in the programme.
Farm Management Plans. These will be tailor made plans for individual Farmers highlighting the changes needed to be made on the farm over 3-5 years in order to reach the full productivity potential.
OFIS users include employees of Olam, farmer group management staff and customers worldwide, in accordance with the mapping software, analysis software and farm management plans in paragraph 2 above.

Your personal data which is held by us will be kept confidential, but it will be shared with OFIS users as highlighted above. Your personal data may be transferred to a place outside your local jurisdiction. Where we do so, subject to applicable privacy law, we will take steps to ensure that the standard of protection accorded to your transferred personal data is comparable to the protection under the applicable privacy law in your local jurisdiction.

You may withdraw any consent given, request for access and/or correction of your personal data and/or request for information regarding our policies and practices, by contacting our Data Protection Officer through ofis@olamnet.com.

We will use and share your personal data as follows
Populating OFIS and Other Olam Databases

We will collect Farmer Data to populate OFIS and other Olam databases where your data can be organized and then analysed to give us important insights such as trends and issues that may affect the supply chain. In order to do so, employees of Olam and its subsidiaries and certain 3rd-party processors will have access to your Farmer Data. These databases and the information in them may be shared with our affiliates, partners, and customers.

We will share the Farmer Data you provide us with our customers and partners (who will also share the Farmer Data with their customers and partners) in order to provide insight into where their food is sourced and who is producing it. This transparency allows buyers to make informed and responsible purchasing decisions.
We will work with our internal teams and service providers to organize, process, and analyse the Farmer Data you share with us in order to identify trends and issues that may affect the supply chain.

We will use your Farmer Data and aggregate OFIS data to help identify opportunities for you to grow your business and operations. If the appropriate opportunity arises, we may present you with opportunities to obtain financing, machinery, farm management advice, farm supplies, and insurance, in addition to sales opportunities - all of which will be provided directly by us or a third-party that we refer to you. Accordingly, these third-parties will be provided access to your Farmer Data.

We will use your Farmer Data to promote the traceability programs we run, including on OFIS, AtSource and other media such as our affiliate websites as well as in direct communications. This means we will use Farmer Data in informational materials and presentations shared among us, our customers (and potential customers), and partners (and potential partners) who may help advance traceability and sustainability.

Olam and its customers and partners will use Farmer Data including names, photographs, videos, location information, product information and interviews (if provided) in advertising materials that will be shared publicly, such as on websites, written publications and on products. The goal is to promote purchases of products such as those produced by you as well as to promote our farmer support, traceability and sustainability initiatives.

We will share your Farmer Data in support of studies by educational, governmental, and non-governmental organisations focused on local farmers, communities, agriculture, supply-chain, traceability, sustainability and related socially conscious studies in order to promote community collaboration and developments in the sustainability and traceability space. Such organisations may also use your Farmer Data in their own electronic or published communications.

When your Farmer Data is shared with third parties such as our customers and partners in furtherance of the Purpose and the specific uses consented to above, each of these customers and partners are data controllers in their own right and you consent to their use of your data as set forth above in Paragraph 1 and as detailed in the Privacy Statement.

You may withdraw consent given, request for access and/or correction of your Farmer Data and/or request for information regarding our policies and practices at any time by contacting us at privacy@olamnet.com. While no disclosure requested is obligatory, failure to supply your Farmer Data and/or subsequent withdrawal of your consent may affect our ability to provide certain services that you may have separately requested from us (as the case may be). For example, your address may be required not only to assist with traceability, but also for us to deliver certain materials to you such as farming supplies. In such instances where you revoke consent, we may retain such data in order to fulfil our contractual obligations to you but will not use such data for any other purpose.

Our Farmer Data Privacy Statement is provided for your reference below. It explains how we handle and protect personal data. While your Farmer Data will be shared with the persons indicated above, your Farmer Data that is held by us will be kept confidential and will be stored on our servers in Singapore and in accordance with applicable privacy laws.

WHERE NOTICE IS READ OUT TO THE INDIVIDUAL BY OLAM STAFF/REPRESENTATIVE:

I confirm that Participant has listened to me read out the Personal Information Collection Notice and they have expressly given their consent for the collection, use, transfer outside of the jurisdiction and disclosure of his/her personal data by Olam for the purposes set out therein.

This policy describes Olam’s and its affiliates use of your Farmer Data collected under the Personal Information Collection Notice signed by you (the “Notice”). It is supplemental to, and should be read together with, the Notice, and the Olam Group Privacy Statement available on www.olamgroup.com/privacy.html. Where there may be any inconsistency, the Notice will prevail over this Farmer Data Privacy Statement and the Olam Group Privacy Statement (in that order).

It is Olam’s policy to comply with all applicable privacy and data protection laws. Olam will collect and use your data only for specified and legitimate purposes, process it in a manner consistent with such purposes, take reasonable steps to ensure that your data is accurate, complete and kept up-to-date (where necessary) and take appropriate measures to provide adequate protection for your data.
For what purposes do we use your data?
What is our legal basis for collecting and processing your data?

We will only collect and process this data with (a) your consent; and (b) where applicable, as required by Olam and our affiliates to conduct our business and pursue our legitimate interests; and (c) for any reasonably expected or legitimate purposes, in accordance with applicable data protection legislation.
Who will we share this data with?

We will share your data with other members of the Olam group, including any affiliates, to achieve the purposes described above. We will also share your data with government authorities and/or law enforcement officials if mandated by law, and any current and future customers, service providers, suppliers and business partners of Olam in pursuing the purposes described above or otherwise with your consent.
Where will we send your data?

Other than sharing with our third party processors for the purposes listed above, from time to time your data may be transferred to one of our affiliates in another country. We will take reasonable steps to ensure that your data is adequately protected in accordance with the relevant data protection legislation which resides over processing of data in that country. Where your personal information is transferred outside the EEA to an Olam affiliate or an entity in a country that is not subject to an adequacy decision by the EU Commission, your personal data will be protected by EU Commission approved cross-border safeguards including standard contractual clauses for cross-border data transfer.
What measures do we have in place to protect your data?

Olam maintains reasonable safeguards to protect the confidentiality, security and integrity of your data. Although we use security measures to help protect your data against unauthorized disclosure we cannot guarantee the security of information provided over the internet and will not be responsible for breaches of security beyond our reasonable control.
What rights do you have in relation to your data?

You may choose not to provide data that we request. You have the right to ask Olam for a copy of your data and to verify, correct or restrict active processing of your data. You can ask Olam to stop using your images at any time, in which case it will not be used in future publications but may continue to appear in publications already in circulation. These rights may be limited in law. If you wish to exercise these rights or have any questions about them, you can contact Olam at the email address provided below.
How long will you retain my data?
Except as otherwise required by law, Olam will retain your personal data for such period that is necessary for the purposes for which the data was collected.

The data controller for your data is Olam International Limited, unless otherwise specified by the relevant Olam entity in your country. If you have any questions relating to the data we hold about you then please email us at privacy@olamnet.com.
The Olam Group Privacy Statement which explains additional ways we collect and use personal data can be found at www.olamgroup.com/privacy.html

There may be a number of ways for consent to be recorded. Please consult the Legal function if your intended collection method is not covered above. The signature fields may be replaced with consent buttons, etc.

Where an Olam representative is reading the notice to the individual and acknowledging his consent on behalf of the individual (e.g. by way of a slide box in a mobile app), please ensure that Olam is able to check which representative has obtained the consent.

Your personal data including your name, age, contact information (e-mail address, phone number, mailing address), photographs, videos or digital recordings, biographical, social and geographical information, financial, farming and output information, feedback from you, and where applicable, those of your children or dependants (“Farmer Data”) will be collected and stored by us and made accessible to our customers, business partners and in some cases, made public on our Olam websites, social media, electronic or written publications. This includes the Olam Farmer Information System ("OFIS") and/or the AtSource platform (“AtSource”) which are online databases and tools containing farmer related data used by us and our customers and partners. We ask that you hereby acknowledge and provide consent to the collection, use and disclosure of your personal data for this purpose in accordance with this Personal Information Collection Notice.

It is requested for you to supply Olam International Limited (hereafter referred to as “Olam,” “us,” or “we”) with personal data in support of Olam’s efforts to promote sustainability and traceability in the supply chain and in-turn to promote responsible trade with farmers such as yourself around the globe (the “Purpose”).
